sn38.6:1.6: “But, reverend, what path and what practice, for realizing this ultimate solace?”
sn38.6:1.7: “Reverend, it is simply this noble eightfold path for realizing this ultimate solace, that is—
sn38.6:1.9: Reverend, this is the path, this is the practice, for realizing this ultimate solace.”
sn38.6:1.10: “Reverend, this is a fine path, a fine practice, for realizing this ultimate solace.
sn38.6:1.11: And just this much is enough for diligence, Reverend Sāriputta.”
